content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICMR NIRWoH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRWoH Senior Consultant Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Consultant (Scientific–Medical): MBBS or equivalent with at least 12 years of post-qualification experience OR retired Government employees in Pay Level-10 and above with 10 years relevant exprience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 40 years Maximum Age: 70 years To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRWoH Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR NIRWoH Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 03 September 2026. There is no online application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or an equivalent qualification. Additionally, they should have at least 12 years of post-qualification experience. Retired government employees with specific experience are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant role?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Senior Consultant position is between 40 years and 70 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, though not detailed here.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,50,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Consultant (Scientific–Medical) position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICMR National Institute for Research on Women's Health in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Senior Consultant position is contractual.
